{{Top|leg}}
'''Ottdefa''' was an academic title given to certain people in the [[Lekua system/Legends|Lekua system]]. It was similar to the title "[[Professor/Legends|professor]]." [[Osuno Whett/Legends|Osuno Whett]] was an Ottdefa.<ref name="LCMS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
